content.content:
## Formelle brev og e-postar -- profesjonell kommunikasjon

I ein globalisert verd er evna til å skrive formelle brev og e-postar på engelsk viktigare enn nokon gong. Anten du søkjer jobb, kontaktar ein organisasjon, klagar på eit produkt, eller skriv til ein offentleg instans -- du treng å beherske det formelle brevet.

I dette kapittelet lærer du:
- Formatet for formelle brev og e-postar
- Høflegheitsfrasar og formelt språk
- Ulike typar formelle brev: søknad, førespurnad, klage
- Skilnaden mellom formelle og uformelle e-postar

content.title: Formal Letter Format
content.content:
**Formelt brev -- oppbygning:**

1. **Avsendaren si adresse** (øvst til høgre)
2. **Dato** (under adressa)
3. **Mottakaren si adresse** (venstre side)
4. **Greeting (helsing):**
   - Dear Sir/Madam, (kjenner ikkje namnet)
   - Dear Mr/Mrs/Ms [Etternamn], (kjenner namnet)
5. **Introduction** -- fortel kvifor du skriv
6. **Body** -- hovudinnhaldet, gjerne 1--2 avsnitt
7. **Conclusion** -- oppsummer og sei kva du ventar
8. **Closing:**
   - Yours faithfully, (til Dear Sir/Madam)
   - Yours sincerely, (til Dear Mr/Mrs [Namn])
9. **Signatur** -- ditt fulle namn

content.title: Nyttige frasar for formelle brev
content.content:
**Innleiing:**
- "I am writing to enquire about..."
- "I am writing to apply for the position of..."
- "I am writing to express my concern about..."
- "I am writing with regard to..."

**Hovuddel:**
- "I would like to inform you that..."
- "I would be grateful if you could..."
- "Furthermore, I would like to point out that..."
- "I would appreciate it if you could..."

**Avslutning:**
- "I look forward to hearing from you."
- "Please do not hesitate to contact me if you require further information."
- "I would appreciate a prompt reply."
- "Thank you for your time and consideration."

content.title: Eksempel: Formell jobbsøknad
content.problem: Skriv eit formelt søknadsbrev for ein sommarjobb i ein bokhandel.
content.solution:
15 Oak Street
Bergen 5003
Norway

10 March 2026

Ms Sarah Johnson
Manager
Chapter One Bookshop
25 High Street
London SW1 2AB

Dear Ms Johnson,

I am writing to apply for the summer assistant position advertised on your website. I am a 15-year-old student from Norway, and I will be visiting London this summer.

I am passionate about reading and have been an active member of my school's book club for three years. I am fluent in both Norwegian and English, and I have experience working with customers from a part-time job at a local cafe. I am hardworking, reliable, and eager to learn.

I am available to work from 20 June to 15 August and can work flexible hours, including weekends.

I have enclosed my CV for your consideration. I would be grateful if you could let me know whether any positions are available.

I look forward to hearing from you.

Yours sincerely,
[Ditt namn]

content.content:
## E-post -- formell vs. uformell

E-post følgjer mange av dei same reglane som brev, men har nokre eigne konvensjonar:

**Formell e-post:**
- Subject line: Kort og skildrande: "Application for summer position"
- Greeting: Dear Mr/Ms [Namn], eller Dear Sir/Madam,
- Ingen samantrekkingar, formelt språk
- Closing: Kind regards, / Best regards, / Yours sincerely,

**Semi-formell e-post (til lærar):**
- Subject line: "Question about homework assignment"
- Greeting: Dear [Lærarnamn], eller Hi [Førenamn],
- Høfleg men ikkje stivt
- Closing: Best regards, / Thanks,

**Uformell e-post (til ven):**
- Subject line: Kort, uformell: "Party on Friday!"
- Greeting: Hey! / Hi [Namn]!
- Samantrekkingar og uformelt språk OK
- Closing: See you! / Talk soon! / Cheers!

subTasks.solution:
Subject: Request for extension on English essay

Dear Ms/Mr [Namn],

I hope this email finds you well. I am writing to explain that I was unable to submit my English essay on time because I was ill last week and missed three days of school.

I have started working on the essay and would be grateful if you could grant me a few extra days to complete it. I believe I can hand it in by Friday.

I apologise for the inconvenience and appreciate your understanding.

Best regards,
[Ditt namn]

content.content:
## Oppsummering

**Formelle brev:**
- Fast format: adresse, dato, helsing, kropp, avslutning
- Dear Sir/Madam → Yours faithfully
- Dear Mr/Ms [Namn] → Yours sincerely

**Nyttige frasar:**
- "I am writing to..." / "I would be grateful if..."
- "I look forward to hearing from you."

**E-post:**
- Formell: Dear + formelt språk + Kind regards
- Semi-formell: Hi/Dear + høfleg men avslappa + Best regards
- Uformell: Hey + uformelt språk + See you

**Viktige reglar:**
- Tilpass registeret til mottakaren
- Ver tydeleg på formålet med brevet/e-posten
- Hald deg kort og presis
- Korrekturles alltid før sending
